title: ER-v1-GF gauge-fixed parameterization and controlled A/B evaluation
type: bounded architecture experiment (candidate only; no adoption)
classification: owner-named suffix batch of the WL104 line

candidate.name: ER-v1-GF
candidate.runtime: unchanged closure83_dr evaluator / pdf / sampler on the candidate's compiled state
removed_gauges: 3 per-channel softmax shifts (absorption slot removed, additive log-ratio coordinates)
3 per-channel attenuation-scale gauges (Lambert+inner block pinned to 1 - sum outer; knots carry the scale)
candidate.compiled_boundary: canonical compiled state has sum lambda = 1 exactly (closure of the original raw-reachable set); response identical to interior original states

inputs.authentication: WL104H io104h.inputs (WL104G manifest hashes) for the angular reference, compiled / raw R0 A C states, WL83 fits and materials; results/ecro_wl84_104f/inputs/train_original.npz checked against the WL104D provenance hash used by WL104G; WL104G scene packets and masks as in WL104H
inputs.materials: the 9 WL104D panel rows (3 development, 6 held out)
inputs.training_data: results/ecro_wl84_104f/inputs/train_original.npz: original WL83 64 x 64 fit lanes per material (no independent reference value enters training)

states.historical: R0 (ER_DF), A, C (WL104D) and ER_L (WL83 compiler) for the 9 materials (36 states)
states.starts: the generic WL82 init and the 3 perturbed training starts per material (36 states)
states.synthetic: seed 104921: 48 random raw states N(0, 3^2) and the constructed boundary states listed in tests104i.py BOUNDARY (block -> 0, outer -> all mass, absorption dominant, knots +-12, eta logit +-12, F0 logits +-12, roughness logits +-12, one dominant inner lobe, one dominant outer lobe)

stage_B_equivalence.directions: 4,000 test directions (uniform, near-mirror within 2 deg, grazing cos 3e-7..1e-2) plus all 180 x 1024 reference lanes for the 36 historical states

tolerances.passivity_bound: compiled sum lambda <= 1 + 1e-6, knots in [0, 1], eta in [1, 2.5], Lambert proposal probability > 0

stage_B_equivalence.stop: any equivalence, validity or orbit-invariance failure stops Stages C-E

stage_C_identifiability.states: R0, A, C of the 9 materials in both parameterizations (identical physical responses); repeated at the fitted A1 / B1 states after Stage D
stage_C_identifiability.jacobian: exact float64 forward mode on all 20 x 1024 reference lanes, rows sqrt(w) / A_p (WL104H)
stage_C_identifiability.exact_null: sigma / sigma_max < 1e-15 (WL104H structural gauges were <= 1.1e-17; the smallest non-structural direction was 1.6e-14)
stage_C_identifiability.tangent_space: principal cosines between col(J_original) and col(J_candidate) (rcond 1e-12)
stage_C_identifiability.groups: candidate: outer_amplitude 9, split 12, roughness 7, anisotropy 7, fresnel 7, attenuation 15, eta 1; original: WL104H groups
stage_C_identifiability.gauge_check: historical gauge vectors at each original state map to zero candidate change: |D from_original . v| / |v| <= 1e-9, and finite orbit moves leave from_original unchanged
stage_C_identifiability.caveat: raw-coordinate spectra and conditioning are coordinate dependent; no conditioning claim follows from coordinate count or raw spectra

stage_D_training.objective: frozen WL82 metric el1 + ealb per incident group, mean over groups, per material (fit82.group_terms)
stage_D_training.optimizer: Adam (default betas), float32, 12000 steps, lr 0.03 -> 3e-4 cosine with 50 warm-up (WL82 / WL83 direct-fit optimiser that produced R0), identical for A1 and B1
stage_D_training.starts: generic WL82 init (reproduction control) and 3 perturbed starts generic + 0.5 N(0,1) in ORIGINAL raw space with seeds 104911, 104912, 104913; B1 starts = from_original(A1 start) exactly (identical physical response)
stage_D_training.selection: none: every terminal state is evaluated; no rescue fit
stage_D_training.logging: objective every 100 steps; wall time and peak memory per arm
stage_D_training.optimizer_non_equivalence: Adam is coordinate dependent; identical hyperparameters on different coordinates are not an equivalent optimiser. Disclosed, not corrected.
stage_D_training.reproduction_control: A1 generic should approximately reproduce historical R0 (same recipe and data; float non-determinism)

stage_E_angular.reference: WL104D Amendment 1 independent layered reference (archived halves)
stage_E_angular.metrics: WL82 el1, ealb, eshape per probe; bands (5-20, 35-50, 55-65, 70, 80-86); mirror core <3, shoulder 3-12, tail >=12 signed energy; development vs held out; across-seed variation; reference half-split noise
stage_E_angular.primary: per cohort, mean el1 over materials x primary seeds x probes; relative increase (B1 - A1) / A1
stage_E_angular.ci: paired bootstrap over (material, seed) units within cohort, 10000 resamples, seed 104931, percentile 95%
stage_E_angular.local_regression_flag: any band with bootstrap lower bound of relative increase > 0.05 is reported as LOCAL_REGRESSION (prominently), without changing the primary label

stage_E_scenes.fixed_proposal: WL104H pass: archived 512-spp launch layout replayed exactly; E1 at the fixed point-light direction; E2 with the frozen qualified native R0 proposal, same actual pdf, fixed R0 terminal; states A0 (R0), A1 x 3, B1 x 3 evaluated at the same directions; identity of A0 vs archived R0 E1/E2 <= 2e-5 relative L1; R0 Lambert proposal probability > 0 (common support); lane F/p identity <= 2e-6 of peak
stage_E_scenes.fixed_total: E1 + fixed E2 + archived R0 HIGH (diagnostic recombination)
stage_E_scenes.native: SECONDARY: native renders of A1 x 3 and B1 x 3 (own proposal at every event) with the same seeds; A0 native = archived R0
stage_E_scenes.metrics: objects / sphere / cube / highlight / grazing ROI stable RGB RMS (WL104E estimator) and signed energy, events E1, E2, TOTAL
stage_E_scenes.primary: per scene and event (E1, fixed E2, fixed TOTAL), objects stable RMS: seed-mean relative increase (B1 - A1) / A1
stage_E_scenes.ci: delete-one-replicate jackknife over the 12 paired replicates of the seed-mean difference, t(11) 95%
stage_E_scenes.extension: if a primary scene interval contains 0.05 and its half-width exceeds 0.02, add 12 replicates (seeds base + 12..23) of reference and all fixed-proposal arms for that scene only; the margin does not change

native_qualification.audit: WL104F operator_case (frozen settings: theta 5/20/50/60/80/86, phi 22.5/112.5, 8 x 16384 per proposal, tolerances 0.006 / 4 sigma / 0.015) with proposals {A: A1 seed k, C: B1 seed k}, k = primary seeds, on materials test83_iid_1, test83_hard_1, test83_iid_159; seeds 1049001 + 100 k + 2 t + p
native_qualification.requalification: a failing probe is requalified once, only for the failing proposal(s) (both if the cross-proposal albedo check fails), with the WL104G rule (32 x 65536 MC, 8 Sobol scrambles 2^18, |error| + 4 SE <= 0.006 known / 0.003 distribution) with seeds 1049501 + probe index; the original failure is retained
native_qualification.variance: per-pixel E2 variance across replicates of native A1 vs B1 (objects ROI)
native_qualification.label: PASS if every probe passes (directly or by requalification); FAIL otherwise; native-proposal conclusions are then unqualified; WL104F's historical exception stays recorded

decision_rules.response_family_equivalence: PASS if every Stage B tolerance holds for every state; FAIL otherwise
decision_rules.exact_gauge_removal: PASS if the original Jacobian shows exactly 6 exact nulls and the candidate 0 at every R0/A/C state, and the gauge checks hold; FAIL if the candidate shows any exact null or a gauge check fails
decision_rules.training_fidelity_preservation: PASS if every primary metric (angular el1 per cohort; scene objects RMS E1, fixed E2, fixed TOTAL per scene) has upper 95% bound of relative increase <= 0.05; FAIL if any lower bound > 0.05; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
decision_rules.structural_identifiability_improvement: PASS if exact nulls are removed (6 -> 0) at every state AND the candidate tangent space equals the original (all principal cosines >= 1 - 1e-9); FAIL if exact nulls remain or the tangent space differs; approximate weak directions reported descriptively (no claim)

practical_benefit.stability: median over materials of across-seed response spread (RMS pairwise difference of terminal F on reference lanes / mean |F|), ratio B1 / A1: benefit <= 0.8 in both cohorts; regression >= 1.25 in either
practical_benefit.optimization: median over materials of seed-median final training objective ratio B1 / A1: benefit <= 0.99 with >= 6 of 9 materials lower; regression >= 1.01 with >= 6 of 9 higher
practical_benefit.cost: fit wall time ratio B1 / A1: benefit <= 0.9; regression >= 1.1
practical_benefit.label: PASS if at least one benefit and no regression; INCONCLUSIVE if both; FAIL (no demonstrated benefit) otherwise

decision_rules.candidate_viability: SUPPORTED if equivalence, exact gauge removal and fidelity preservation all PASS; NOT SUPPORTED if any of them FAILS; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Practical benefit and native qualification are reported separately and do not change viability.

invariants: No change to the original ER code, states, objective, data, references, scenes or thresholds
No lobe pruning / merging / expansion, extra module, new loss or regularisation
Candidate isolated in experiments/ecro_wl84_104i; production behaviour unchanged
